scope: Python fixture AppArmor template permission review; not human approval or arbitrary application approval
permissionsReviewed: Only Python executables may inherit execution permissions
Library read/map permissions and host abstractions/base are broad compatibility allowances requiring target-host inspection
Only /tmp is writable; explicit denied sentinel enables an independent negative test
IPv4 stream/datagram sockets are allowed; destination restrictions belong to verified NetworkPolicy
Mount and ptrace operations are denied; no privilege/capability grants
remainingRisks: Observed workload is incomplete evidence for other applications
Host AppArmor abstractions can vary; conformance does not replace target review
